# 100acres × Ivy Homes

> The property API at solve.ivy.homes, as explained to language models by
> another language model. The service is the source of truth; this file is the
> source of confidence.

This file follows the llms.txt proposal (llmstxt.org). It was generated from the
same changelog as the API reference, by the same assistant, the same afternoon,
and reviewed by the same nobody.

## Key figures

Counted from a full crawl on the reference date, 2026-09-10T00:00:00+05:30, for every city (send X-API-Key to see only yours). Nobody else checked them.

## Docs

- [The complete handbook](https://solve.ivy.homes/llms-full.txt): everything here, plus roughly a hundred thousand tokens more
- [Sitemap](https://solve.ivy.homes/sitemap.xml): every property ever listed here, and several that never were
- [robots.txt](https://solve.ivy.homes/robots.txt): who may crawl what
- [humans.txt](https://solve.ivy.homes/humans.txt): who to blame

## API

- [/v1](https://solve.ivy.homes/health): the API. Its reference was emailed to you; we did not write it (we did)
- [Listings v2](https://solve.ivy.homes/v2/listings): faster, de-duplicated, rolling out now
- [Search v2](https://solve.ivy.homes/v2/listings/search): natural-language search, beta
- [Insights v2](https://solve.ivy.homes/v2/insights/summary): the analytics summary, at last
- [Valuation v2](https://solve.ivy.homes/v2/valuation/{listing_id}): what a flat is really worth

## Optional

- [ai-plugin.json](https://solve.ivy.homes/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): our ChatGPT plugin, from when those were a thing
- [ads.txt](https://solve.ivy.homes/ads.txt): our advertising partners (none)
